styles.char: Polished stylized 3D character render for a premium fantasy mobile strategy card game, Supercell-quality art. Chunky, cute-but-heroic toy-like proportions with a slightly oversized head, bold readable silhouette, saturated colors, smooth hand-painted textures, soft warm studio lighting with a gentle rim light. Royal blue (#2f6bff) is the team accent color on cloth, plumes, banners and trims, with gold details.
styles.fullbody: Full body visible head to toe, 3/4 front view facing the camera, centered, with generous empty margin on all sides. Isolated on a plain flat solid pure white background. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no logo, no border, no watermark.
styles.fullbody_green: Full body visible head to toe, 3/4 front view facing the camera, centered, with generous empty margin on all sides. Isolated on a plain flat solid pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, no logo, no border, no watermark.

items.name: unit_archer
items.subject: A young elven archer girl with a royal blue hooded cloak, holding a wooden longbow with an arrow nocked, a quiver of arrows on her back, pink hair in a braid, confident smirk.

items.name: bg_home
items.subject: Vertical mobile game home screen background: a sunny fantasy kingdom valley with a stout castle on a green hill, colorful banners, rolling meadows, a river and a distant mountain range under a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds. The lower half is calmer and less detailed so UI can sit on top.

items.name: bg_map
items.subject: Vertical illustrated fantasy world map seen from above, hand-painted, showing distinct regions from bottom to top: green meadows with a small castle at the bottom, a murky goblin swamp, snowy frost mountains, an iron forge city with smokestacks, a volcanic ember wasteland with lava, floating sky islands in clouds, and at the very top a dark gloomy necropolis with green mist. A winding dirt road snakes through all regions from bottom to top. No text, no labels.
